sources.method: 25.4 mm per inch x the inch figures of sources[0] (Georgia Tech retroTECH record, labelled height x width x depth): width 15.5 in = 393.7, height 2.75 in = 69.85, depth 9 in = 228.6 mm; exact products, no rounding.

sources.quote: Slide the POWER switch on the Master Component to OFF.
If at any point in the game you wish to start over, simply press the RESET button.
The Master Component contains two Hand Controllers which are attached to the video console coil cables.
The Intellivision is a home video game console released by Mattel Electronics in 1979.
The Intellivision is a home video game console released by Mattel Electronics in 1979.

notes: Envelope: Georgia Tech Archives, Digital Media Lab retroTECH Collection (RT00033), item 'Mattel Intellivision console, 1979', model number '2609 A', serial 933540 - an archival collection record publishing the object's measurements with labelled axes (museum tier); the bare console (the extent line counts '1 retroTECH Item(s)'). Inches only, hence the derived source.

Quotes from an archive.org scan of the maker's own printed manual are taken from the scan's OCR text layer (the item's _djvu.txt), byte for byte; where a quoted sentence wraps in the scan, the two OCR lines are joined with one space. The archive.org scan of the maker's document counts as primary. Manual: Intellivision Master Component owner's manual, bilingual English/French, '© Mattel, Inc. 1978' (archive.org item Intellivision_Master_Component_1978_Mattel_US).

controls filed as POWER switch and RESET button; the 'CH3-CH4' channel switch on the underside has no §3 kind and is omitted. The original manual's text 'the AC power cord ma[y] be pushed inside of Master Component' indicates a captive cord, but the OCR line is not clean: features.power_inlet left null.

media NOT filed: 'Insert the cartridge into the slot on the right side of the Master Component' - a side-loading slot has no §3 media kind (vocabulary gap). controller_bays not filed: the manual says the cable coils 'beneath it in the cradle' without a count.

Not used: CHM 102674783 is the boxed set ('Dimensions are of box only'); Science Museum Group co8094234 (earlier read: 'overall: 230 mm x 380 mm x 65 mm', axes unlabelled) now refuses automated fetches (403) - human visit, and unlabelled anyway. The 1979-04-09 'Instruction Manual' item on archive.org is a Mattel service-department letter, not the manual.
